Spring Training 2027 in Arizona: ballpark drop-off, parking and rides

A spring training ride from Scottsdale Sprinters starts with the day your group is having: a ballpark crew or a bachelor weekend at the game, a family or a fan club with a few games on the list, or a VIP day in the Maybach Jet. This guide covers the ten Cactus League ballparks with only what the league, the teams and the ballparks publish, and says plainly what is announced closer to the date.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

Is there parking at Scottsdale Stadium, and where is the drop-off?

Very little. The Giants say parking at Scottsdale Stadium is very limited, with a select number of spaces at the Scottsdale Library and Civic Center, and they encourage fans to walk, bike or take rideshare. The drop-off zones are at Gate A on 75th Street and Gate E on Drinkwater Boulevard, and gates open 2 hours before game time. The Osborn Road lot is reserved for Giants and City of Scottsdale personnel only, so it is not a place to park or to wait. The stadium has four gates: Home Plate Plaza at Drinkwater Boulevard and Osborn Road, Gate A in centerfield facing 75th Street, Gate E on the third-base side along Drinkwater Boulevard, and Gate F in the left-field corner. The Giants list the Gate A and Gate E drop-off zones under accessibility. We treat them as the stadium’s published drop-off points, never as a spot reserved for us: the chauffeur unloads at the zone, or where stadium and city staff direct, and the group walks in from there. A 2027 spring training trolley has not been announced. The chauffeured alternative is the simple one: we pick the group up at the hotel or home, nobody hunts for one of the few spaces, and the vehicle comes back for the ride home after the last out. Game times are announced closer to the date, so the pickup is set once the league posts them.

Where do you park at Sloan Park, and where do rideshares drop off?

Sloan Park’s lots open 4 hours before Cubs spring training games, and gameday parking is first come, first served and cashless, by credit card. Rideshares drop off and pick up outside the Right Field Gate, across Sheffield Avenue, and a free shuttle runs from Mesa Riverview, across from the park, to Cubs home games. Tempe Marketplace also runs a trolley to and from Cubs home games at Sloan Park. Both shuttles drop off at the First Base Gate. Parking prices depend on the lot, and the Cubs sell a limited number of pre-sale single-game and group spaces in the Purple Lot. Sloan Park is the Cubs’ spring home in Mesa, and the league’s last game of 2027, the Brewers at the Cubs on Tuesday, March 23, is played there. A chauffeured group uses the published rideshare point outside the Right Field Gate, or unloads where staff direct, and meets the vehicle at the same side of Sheffield Avenue after the game.

Where do rideshares and drop-offs go at Salt River Fields?

Salt River Fields at Talking Stick, at 7555 North Pima Road in Scottsdale, suggests the access road along the grass-field parking lots, or the Centerfield Parking Lots, for pickup and drop-off. There are 3 entrances off Pima Road. It is the spring home of the Diamondbacks and the Rockies. The ballpark’s 2027 lot prices and its accessible drop-off are not yet published: its A to Z still describes the 2026 season, so this page prints neither. Our Salt River Fields arrival guide keeps the venue’s own sources in one place. Salt River Fields and Scottsdale Stadium are the two Scottsdale ballparks. For the ride back, the group gathers at one pedestrian point first and the trip lead confirms the vehicle’s position before anyone walks toward traffic; event-day signs and staff direct the actual vehicle movement.

Where do you park and get dropped off at the other Cactus League ballparks?

Each park sets its own rules. Camelback Ranch, Peoria Sports Complex and Surprise Stadium park free, and Goodyear Ballpark is free with a game ticket; Hohokam Stadium is cash only, and Tempe Diablo and American Family Fields are cashless or card only. Only Peoria publishes a bus drop-off, at Mariners Way off 83rd Avenue. Camelback Ranch-Glendale (the Dodgers and the White Sox): parking is free, with no overnight parking, and the gates open 60 minutes before first pitch. No rideshare or drop-off zone is published, so the chauffeur unloads where ballpark staff direct. Hohokam Stadium in Mesa (the Athletics): on-site parking is cash only, and the gates open 1.5 hours before game time. No rideshare or drop-off zone is published. Tempe Diablo Stadium (the Angels): rideshare drop-off and pickup is just outside the Alameda Drive entrance to the west parking lot, and no pickup or drop-off is allowed inside that lot. Both lots are entered from Alameda Drive and open 2.5 hours before home games, and the venue is cashless. American Family Fields of Phoenix (the Brewers): drop-offs and rideshares use the designated space along 53rd Avenue and Indian School, outside the parking lot. Parking is sold on the day only, by card, with more charged for oversized and larger vehicles, and the lots open 3 hours before the game. Peoria Sports Complex, 16101 North 83rd Avenue (the Padres and the Mariners): rideshare pickup and drop-off is near Stadium Way and Paradise Lane, just west of the Gate D entrance. Buses enter at Mariners Way off 83rd Avenue, where the bus passenger drop-off is. Parking is free, with no overnight parking, and the gates typically open 90 minutes before the published game time. Surprise Stadium (the Rangers and the Royals): the designated rideshare and drop-off loading zone is just north of the Surprise Aquatic Center. Parking is free, with more than 1,600 spaces, and the gates open 1.5 hours before game time. Goodyear Ballpark, 1933 South Ballpark Way (the Guardians and the Reds): rideshare pickup and drop-off is in the VIP parking lot, reached from Wood Boulevard north of Lower Buckeye Road, and drop-off is also available at the Third Base Entrance. Parking is free with a game ticket, with no overnight parking, and the gates open 1.5 hours before game time.

When is spring training in Arizona in 2027?

As scheduled by the Cactus League, Opening Day is Friday, February 19, 2027, with 8 games, and the last Cactus League game is Tuesday, March 23, 2027. That is 229 games in about five weeks. Game times are announced closer to the date: the league lists every one of them as to be determined. One date to know before you book: Major League Baseball’s collective bargaining agreement with its players is set to expire on December 1, 2026. The dates on this page are the Cactus League’s published schedule. We recheck them after December 1 and update this page if the league changes anything. If a game you planned around moves, every booking allows one free date change when you ask 72 or more hours before pickup, subject to availability: the deposit travels to the new date and the new date’s rate applies. Saturday and Sunday games in the Cactus League window, February 19 to March 23, 2027, are major-event dates on our booking calendar, so they run on the 60-day major-event cancellation window, with the deposit non-refundable. Weekday games follow the standard or large-group terms, depending on the size of the group. The booking step flags a major-event date before anything is paid.

Where is spring training in Arizona, and which teams play where?

Fifteen Major League teams train at 10 ballparks around Phoenix: Scottsdale Stadium and Salt River Fields in Scottsdale, Sloan Park and Hohokam Stadium in Mesa, Tempe Diablo Stadium, Camelback Ranch-Glendale, American Family Fields of Phoenix, Peoria Sports Complex, Surprise Stadium and Goodyear Ballpark. Scottsdale Stadium: the Giants. Salt River Fields at Talking Stick: the Diamondbacks and the Rockies. Sloan Park: the Cubs. Hohokam Stadium: the Athletics. Tempe Diablo Stadium: the Angels. Camelback Ranch-Glendale: the Dodgers and the White Sox. American Family Fields of Phoenix: the Brewers. Peoria Sports Complex: the Padres and the Mariners. Surprise Stadium: the Rangers and the Royals. Goodyear Ballpark: the Guardians and the Reds. The two Scottsdale parks, the two Mesa parks and Tempe Diablo are in the East Valley; Camelback Ranch, American Family Fields, Peoria, Surprise and Goodyear are in the West Valley. A two-ballpark day is simplest between neighbours, and it is one hourly booking: the first game, lunch, the second park and the ride home, confirmed once both game times are posted. Which team plays where on a given day is the league’s to publish. Check the official Cactus League schedule for the game, buy the tickets from the teams, and send us the game or games; we build the pickup, the wait and the return around them in writing.

Which vehicle fits a spring training group?

Match the vehicle to the day: ballpark crews and bachelor groups ride a Limo Party Sprinter or the Party Bus (28 Pax), families and fan clubs take the Executive Black Sprinter or an executive coach for up to 29, and VIP groups ride the Maybach Jet Sprinter or the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter. Ballpark crews and bachelor groups: the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is a nightclub on wheels with a wet bar for 13, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is our most spacious Sprinter, a lounge for 16 with four wet bars, and the Party Bus (28 Pax) puts 28 on limo seating on a wood floor when the whole crew comes. These are party rides, for a group out to celebrate. Families and fan clubs: the Executive Black Sprinter and the Executive White Sprinter seat 14 each in reclining leather, a cup holder at every seat and room for the gear. The Mini Bus (24 Pax) (24 seats) and the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) (29 seats) carry a fan club or a company outing in one pickup. VIP groups: the Maybach Jet Sprinter leads, 9 seats with four Maybach massage recliners and a wet bar. The Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter seats 15 in a fiber-optic lounge with ultra-premium sound, our pick for a ballpark day that ends in Old Town. The Maybach Shuttle Sprinter seats 8 in custom Maybach seats, and the Luxury SUV (Suburban) carries up to 6. Count riders for each direction. A group that arrives together for first pitch does not always leave together, and anyone leaving with another group comes off the return list before the chauffeur plans the pickup.

Can a party bus, limo or charter drop off at a spring training ballpark?

Only Peoria Sports Complex publishes a bus rule: buses enter at Mariners Way off 83rd Avenue, where the bus passenger drop-off is. None of the 10 ballparks publishes a permit rule for limos or party buses, so our chauffeur uses the park’s published drop-off or rideshare zone, or unloads where staff direct. Two other published rules matter for a bigger vehicle. American Family Fields charges more for oversized and larger vehicles that park, and Tempe Diablo Stadium allows no pickup or drop-off inside its west lot. Where the vehicle waits during the game is confirmed with the reservations team before the day, not decided at the gate. For the ride back, name one meeting point and one trip lead before the group goes in. After the last out the lead counts heads, confirms the vehicle’s position with the chauffeur and walks the group there together, rather than everyone chasing a map pin at once. We are a chauffeured transportation service. We do not sell tickets, parking passes or admission, and a ride includes none of them. Questions this page does not answer go to the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Frequently asked questions

When is spring training in Arizona in 2027?

As scheduled by the Cactus League, Opening Day is Friday, February 19, 2027, with eight games, and the last Cactus League game is Tuesday, March 23, 2027. Game times are announced closer to the date.

Where is spring training in Arizona?

At ten ballparks around Phoenix: Scottsdale Stadium and Salt River Fields in Scottsdale, Sloan Park and Hohokam Stadium in Mesa, Tempe Diablo Stadium, Camelback Ranch-Glendale, American Family Fields of Phoenix, Peoria Sports Complex, Surprise Stadium and Goodyear Ballpark.

What teams have spring training in Arizona?

Fifteen: the Giants, the Diamondbacks and Rockies, the Dodgers and White Sox, the Cubs, the Athletics, the Angels, the Brewers, the Padres and Mariners, the Rangers and Royals, and the Guardians and Reds.

What is the Cactus League?

Major League Baseball’s spring training in Arizona. In 2027, as scheduled by the Cactus League, 15 teams play 229 games at 10 ballparks from February 19 to March 23.

Is there parking at Scottsdale Stadium?

Very little. The Giants say parking is very limited, with a select number of spaces at the Scottsdale Library and Civic Center, and encourage walking, biking or rideshare. The drop-off zones are at Gate A on 75th Street and Gate E on Drinkwater Boulevard.

Where do you park at Sloan Park?

The lots open four hours before Cubs spring training games; parking is first come, first served and cashless. Rideshares use the point outside the Right Field Gate, across Sheffield Avenue, and a free shuttle runs from Mesa Riverview.

Where do rideshares drop off at Salt River Fields?

On the access road along the grass-field parking lots, or at the Centerfield Parking Lots. Salt River Fields is at 7555 North Pima Road, with three entrances off Pima Road.

Where do you park at Camelback Ranch?

Parking at Camelback Ranch-Glendale is free, with no overnight parking, and the gates open 60 minutes before first pitch. No rideshare or drop-off zone is published.

Could the MLB labor talks change the 2027 dates?

MLB’s collective bargaining agreement with its players is set to expire on December 1, 2026. The dates here are the Cactus League’s published schedule; we recheck them after December 1, and every booking allows one free date change 72 or more hours before pickup.

Do you sell spring training tickets or parking?

No. We sell chauffeured transportation only. Tickets come from the teams and the league, and parking from the ballparks; with a chauffeured ride, nobody in the group needs a parking space.
